# Goal
Tameshi round 16 (hyaku phase 2), residual re-read (after wave 2). Lane axes depth + calibration (verification-fixture craft). Wave 1 produced work at lane commit 05a224754db3c6fce18f5ec1816a6873bffe3d0e (pushed). Every item below attacks one named artifact or re-executes one named instruction set; report what you observe, including agreement. The L1 (TameshiR16) integrates; seats advise and never judge the round.
# Contract
- Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>. Tools start at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin: use absolute paths everywhere; never write under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin outside the lane root.
- Your report is your only write unless your Target names another absolute path you own. Scratch only under `mktemp -d /tmp/tameshi-r16w2-<YourName>-XXXXXX`. No commits, no git add, no edits to lane files you do not own. Read lane files at commit 05a224754db3c6fce18f5ec1816a6873bffe3d0e via `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin show 05a224754db3c6fce18f5ec1816a6873bffe3d0e:<path>` when your Target says so; run lane tools from a /tmp copy of their committed bytes unless your Target says otherwise.
- Messaging: only `write` with path exactly `agent://TameshiR16` (a bare id writes a stray file at the fleet root). Never agent://all, Main or other lanes' agents. Message only for blockers.
- Leaf seats: no delegation (executors and mutation-testers may spawn at most one read-only labrat), no background jobs. Execute what your Target says to execute, in /tmp.
- Sibling repos and domain trees are read-only: `git -C <repo> show <rev>:<path>` into /tmp; use `git --no-optional-locks -C <repo> status --porcelain` for status. Never edit MANIFEST.json, fleet scripts/templates, .ufo/state/.
- Never read/copy/query ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files; never launch the omp CLI; REA MCP is disabled.
- Tooling: you may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason). pacman guard: ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — install only via `uv tool`/`npx`/an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, never restart a host service.
- Honesty: an unrun check has not passed; report commands, exits and key output lines; mark inference.
# Cold-read interface (RR* seats only)
Page = `git show 05a224754db3c6fce18f5ec1816a6873bffe3d0e:SKILL.md` (sha256 e289acec4e90c994d303b2dd6c844d907dc1bf48330ecd2fd253ac7379f794b3); verify the sha first. Read only your assigned line range plus files, commands or URLs that range explicitly names; never open LOG.md, SCORECARD.md, SHONEN.md, plans/, reports/, corpus/lessons/, .ufo/waves/, any other seat's report, or any SKILL.md lines outside your range (in particular not the errata section unless it is your range). Classify each section instruction (tells the reader to act) or record (reports what happened); execute instructions in /tmp, re-check at least one concrete anchor per claim cluster of a record at the revision the record names. End the report with exactly one fenced ```json block: {"seat":"<Name>","skill_sha256":"e289acec4e90c994d303b2dd6c844d907dc1bf48330ecd2fd253ac7379f794b3","sections":[{"start":<heading line>,"heading":"<exact heading line>","class":"instruction|record","verdict":"executed-ok|verified-record|gap-minor|gap-blocking|wrong-expectation|not-executed","blocking_gaps":[],"wrong_expectations":[],"minor_gaps":[],"commands_executed":[],"opened":[],"scratch":"/tmp/..."}]}. executed-ok/verified-record mean no gap at all; any named minor gap → gap-minor.
